video_title: De'Anthony Melton's sharp shooting fuels win over Kings | Dubs Talk Live | NBC Sports Bay Area

quotes.speaker: Dalton Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' offensive performance against the Kings' defense
quotes.excerpt: The Warriors feasted on that Kings defense early with 44 points in the first quarter.
quotes.quote: The Warriors feasted on that Kings defense early with 44 points in the first quarter. That is half of what they scored the entire game against the Boston Celtics. The ball was moving, that is what I really liked in the first quarter, and then it just carried on. They did get outscored in the final three quarters, but when you set that tone in the first quarter and you wind up with 37 assists on the night, good things are going to happen.
quotes.social_post: The Warriors offense looked sharp early against the Kings, putting up 44 points in the first quarter. Dalton Johnson notes that ball movement was the key to setting the tone in the win.

structured.context: Dalton Johnson analyzes the Warriors offensive performance against the Kings defense.

quotes.speaker: Dalton Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Defensive lapses in the third quarter against the Kings
quotes.excerpt: The defensive rotations were not there in the third quarter, way too many open threes.
quotes.quote: In the third quarter, you saw them get more sloppy with the ball. The defensive rotations were not there in the third quarter, way too many open threes for the Kings, and the Kings simply started making shots. They started making their three-point shots, and that is how they crawled back in this game. Getting to four points on multiple occasions, you are starting to sweat a little bit.
quotes.social_post: Dalton Johnson highlights the Warriors defensive lapses in the third quarter against the Kings, noting that too many open threes allowed Sacramento to crawl back into the game.

structured.context: Dalton Johnson discusses the defensive lapses that allowed the Kings to close the gap in the third quarter.

quotes.speaker: Dalton Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Financial impact of the NBA Cup on two-way players
quotes.excerpt: Imagine what that 500,000 does for the people near the back of the bench.
quotes.quote: Imagine what that 500,000 does for the people near the back of the bench, the guys that do not have guaranteed contracts, the two-way players. Brandon Williams talked about it, and he is like, 'Yeah, I am all in.' He is on a cheaper one-year deal, and he will take that any day.
quotes.social_post: The NBA Cup prize money is a major motivator for players on two-way contracts. Dalton Johnson points out that for guys like Brandon Williams, that 500,000 is a life-changing amount of money.

structured.context: Dalton Johnson discusses the financial impact of the NBA Cup prize money on players with non-guaranteed contracts.

quotes.speaker: Dalton Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Anthony Melton's impact on the Warriors' offense
quotes.excerpt: When someone like De'Anthony Melton gets going from three-point range, that is a huge start.
quotes.quote: When someone like De'Anthony Melton gets going from three-point range, that is a huge start right there. This was truly a strength in numbers game when you think about other people giving De'Anthony Melton the ample help around him, and the bench outscoring the Kings 61 to 19 tonight. That is how this team needs to win.
quotes.social_post: De'Anthony Melton provided a massive boost for the Warriors, helping the bench outscore the Kings 61 to 19. Dalton Johnson emphasizes that this was a total team effort.

structured.context: Dalton Johnson highlights the impact of De'Anthony Melton's shooting on the Warriors' victory.

quotes.speaker: Dalton Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Spotlight on the matchup between Yaxel Lendeborg and Darius Acuff Jr.
quotes.excerpt: If he is going against a Darius Acuff Jr., that is going to be the spotlight game.
quotes.quote: Whenever a top pick goes against another top pick, and for this season for the Warriors that is going to be Yaxel Lendeborg. If he is going against a Darius Acuff Jr., that is going to be the spotlight game. I just think that they had much different nights. Yaxel Lendeborg winds up gutting out this win, and he still found his way to lead the Warriors with eight rebounds and 15 points.
quotes.social_post: Dalton Johnson breaks down the matchup between Yaxel Lendeborg and Darius Acuff Jr., noting that Lendeborg stepped up with 15 points and 8 rebounds to help secure the win.

structured.context: Dalton Johnson compares the performances of Yaxel Lendeborg and Darius Acuff Jr. in their recent matchup.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Williams on his physical condition and team role
quotes.excerpt: That is my job, that is what they brought me in to do.
quotes.quote: That is my job, that is what they brought me in to do, to keep that offense running when the starting point guard comes out, so the offense does not look stagnant. I know my job, I know my role, and I am going to do that as much as I can.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Williams on his role with the Warriors: That is my job, that is what they brought me in to do, to keep that offense running when the starting point guard comes out, so the offense does not look stagnant.

structured.context: Brandon Williams explains his understanding of his role as a backup point guard for the Warriors.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Williams on the Road Runner sound effect
quotes.excerpt: I would want like an engine going or something like that, that would be more lit.
quotes.quote: I would want like an engine going or something like that, that would be more lit, but I am not mad at the meep-meep. I think George kind of started that in preseason and stuff, but I am not mad at it. I would rather have a Ferrari or something, an engine going crazy, but I will take the meep-meep.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Williams is not a huge fan of the Road Runner meep-meep sound effect. He says I would rather have a Ferrari or something, an engine going crazy, but I will take the meep-meep.

structured.context: Brandon Williams reacts to the Road Runner sound effect associated with his play.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Williams on the motivation of the NBA Cup
quotes.excerpt: I know exactly what I need to fill in and what the team needed more than anything.
quotes.quote: I know exactly what I need to fill in and what the team needed more than anything, especially with Steph going down. They brought me in for a reason, I know my role, I know exactly what I need to do, and I need to come out here and do XYZ. I am glad I got out there and showed it in 12 minutes and 44 seconds.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Williams discusses stepping up in the absence of Steph Curry, stating he knows exactly what he needs to do to fill his role for the team.

structured.context: Brandon Williams discusses his mindset and preparation to fill the void left by Stephen Curry's injury.

quotes.speaker: Dalton Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green's offensive evolution at the four position
quotes.excerpt: He is going into that new position for him, playing four instead of the five.
quotes.quote: He is going into that new position for him, playing four instead of the five. It is a little bit of a different spot having a Charles Barkley. That is big for Draymond Green. I think it takes a little bit of that load off of him defensively, and it is okay, I am going to let it fly. No Steph, let us let this thing fly, but I am also going to find ways to drop some dimes too. So a really good offensive game from Draymond tonight.
quotes.social_post: Dalton Johnson discusses Draymond Green playing the four instead of the five, noting that it takes some of the defensive load off him and allows him to be more aggressive offensively.

structured.context: Dalton Johnson analyzes Draymond Green's offensive performance while playing the four position.

quotes.speaker: Dalton Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry's injury status and re-evaluation timeline
quotes.excerpt: Steph Curry's re-evaluation will come Friday before that Blazers game.
quotes.quote: Steph Curry's re-evaluation will come Friday before that Blazers game. We will talk to us soon thereafter. So the re-evaluation will come Friday before that Blazers game.
quotes.social_post: Steph Curry will be re-evaluated this Friday before the game against the Blazers. We should have a clearer picture of his status shortly after that.

structured.context: Dalton Johnson provides an update on the re-evaluation timeline for Stephen Curry's injury.
